title: Social data model + RLS + rate-limits (environments, ratings, reports, leaderboard, moderation) (AUTH #026)
summary: Supabase migrations for the social tables (environments, publishes, ratings, reports, leaderboard_times, moderation_actions) with RLS on every table and the locked policy patterns: owner-only for drafts and creator stats, published-read (published AND moderation-cleared) for public browse/play, service-role-only for the moderation queue and ranking jobs. Ratings, reports, and time submissions are rate-limited per user and device (SPEC §3.7; security-sensitive → secondary review, AUTH #007).

acceptance_tests.test: Every new table enables RLS with at least one policy in the same migration (supabase/scripts/check_rls.py green); policies implement owner-only, published-read (published AND cleared), and service-role-only per SECURITY_CHECKLIST §2.2.
A two-user + anon test proves an unpublished or not-yet-cleared environment is invisible to others, and a published+cleared one is readable; a moderation-queue row is service-role-only.
Ratings, reports, and leaderboard-time submissions are rate-limited per user and device (SECURITY_CHECKLIST §10.2).
No secret appears in the repo; secret-scan green.

history.event: created by the Coordinator (M4 decomposition, AUTH #026).

Draft migration in design/proposals/m4-data-01-social/ (publishes, ratings, reports, leaderboard_times, moderation_actions, user_blocks, rate_limit_rules): RLS on every table (owner-only / published-read / service-role-only), narrowed column grants, per-user + per-device rate-limit trigger (P0429; server clock; advisory lock; service role exempt). 31 pytest cases on a throwaway PostgreSQL with a Supabase stand-in cover AT-1/AT-2/AT-3 (all pass locally on PG 17; a mutation check fails 10). Not applied anywhere. Table-creation AUTH request filed → blocked on the AUTH + secondary review.

APPROVED as AUTH #038 (Owner, re-confirmed 2026-09-29). Coordinator secondary security review complete (AUTH #027): check_rls.py green on the draft (RLS + a policy on every created table); #038 conditions all present — hashed cross-account device_hash (+ privacy label), user_blocks (Apple 1.2), leaderboards expose a handle not a raw user id, narrowed client grants, §10.2 per-user/per-device rate-limit trigger; the 31 RLS/rate-limit tests pass in CI (local ERRORs are only this sandbox's initdb failing to start PostgreSQL). Migration is staging-ready. Two of the three blockers cleared (AUTH + secondary review); the remaining step is the Operator's apply to Supabase staging.

Applied the AUTH #038 migration to Supabase STAGING only (never production): moved the draft unchanged under an APPROVED #038 header to supabase/migrations/20261002164500_m4_social.sql and applied it via the session pooler with psql --single-transaction ON_ERROR_STOP, recording version 20261002164500 in supabase_migrations.schema_migrations in the same transaction. Verified live: 7 new tables present; RLS enabled on all 8 public tables with 0 lacking RLS or a policy; 21 policies (owner-only / published-read / service-role-only); rate_limit_rules seeded (ratings 30/45 per h, reports 10/15 per h, leaderboard_times 20/30 per 10 min); BEFORE INSERT rate-limit triggers on ratings/reports/leaderboard_times; enforce_rate_limit not executable by anon/authenticated. Live rolled-back role smoke 8 PASS / 0 FAIL (anon+user denied on moderation_actions, anon sees published+cleared only, rating a draft rejected by RLS, client cannot set time status, 21st time in 10 min -> P0429, anon sees no pending times; 0 rows persisted). staging_smoke.py 12 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 PENDING (db.rls_every_table 8 tables, db.migrations 2). check_rls green; 31 RLS/rate-limit pytest pass on local PG 17. Evidence: qa/reports/M4-DATA-01.md, qa/reports/STAGING-smoke.md, supabase/scripts/m4_social_live_smoke.sql. Commit ba4b58e on main; CI green (governance, lint incl. the 31 RLS tests, supabase-local live-RLS, secret-scan, unity-tests). All required ATs met -> in-review (Coordinator secondary review of the apply).
